message.content:
The U.S. Declaration of Independence was **adopted on July 4, 1776**, which is the date most people celebrate.  
However, the actual signing of the document by the Continental Congress took place later—**August 2, 1776**.  

So, while July 4 is the official “independence day,” the formal signing occurred on August 2.
